text:
Dosing is something her pediatrician needs to confirm — please call their office now or go to an urgent care line today.

Two days at 39.5°C with unusual sleepiness in an 18-month-old is worth a same-day call at minimum. Her doctor will ask her weight to calculate the right ibuprofen dose, and they'll want to assess her given how long the fever has lasted.

If she seems hard to wake, is breathing strangely, or has a rash, go to the ER rather than waiting for a callback.
